title: Sidebar
description: Vertical navigation list with an active item, an icon-only collapsed mode, drag-resize, and a block or pill item style. The site's left nav is one (#829).

items.description: Items as a JSON array of {id, label, href, icon, target}, or comma-separated label#href pairs

active.description: The id or label of the item to highlight; it also gets aria-current="page"

collapsed.description: Icon-only mode: each item's label becomes its aria-label and tooltip

resizable.description: Adds a drag handle on the right edge (arrow keys resize it too)

width.description: Width in px (a bare number) or any CSS length

resizeMin.description: Smallest width, in px: the sidebar is never narrower, whether dragged, set by width or styled. Unset: 10rem, and 60px for a drag

resizeMax.description: Largest width, in px: the sidebar is never wider, whether dragged, set by width or styled. Unset: the container's width, and 600px for a drag

itemstyle.description: block: the full-width fill. pill: the active fill inset from both walls and fully rounded (#828)

--x-sidebar-width.description: Width, set by the width attribute and by dragging the handle

wb:sidebar:resize.description: The width changed to a px value
